title: Women's Color Coordination Guides
description: Choose clothing colors by shade, contrast, fabric and proportion, with guides for matching tops, trousers and skirts from the wardrobe you own.
primary_intent: These focused guides bring the examples above into the same directory, so you can compare an individual shade or a tonal outfit before changing another part of the combination.

title: Outfit Guides by Occasion and Destination
description: Plan outfits for travel, cafes, concerts, weddings and Tet by considering movement, weather, venue requirements and the clothes you already own.
primary_intent: These additional situations connect the practical checks above with a more specific day out, season or destination. Use the actual itinerary to choose which guide to open.

title: Women's Clothing Care Guides
description: Find clothing care guides for washing, storage, leather, boots, fit adjustments and hems, using garment labels and construction to choose the next step.
primary_intent: The remaining guides focus on the small adjustments mentioned in the text, from a stable tuck to a useful lace pattern. Choose the task after checking whether the item already fits.

title: Alternative Hair and Makeup Guides
description: Coordinate alternative hair, makeup and nails with necklines, clothing colors and occasions, with practical guides for choosing a manageable level of detail.
primary_intent: Browse the individual cuts, color ideas and finishing options discussed above. Each guide addresses a different choice, so you can keep the rest of the outfit settled while exploring one change.
